disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全树搜索了敏感凭据路径（凭证文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据等）与读取这类路径的代码，未发现命中。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree for sensitive credential paths (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, etc.) and code that reads such paths; no hits found.

checked_items.zh: 插件唯一读取的密钥是 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY（环境变量或自身配置目录里的 .env），用于调用 DeepSeek 官方视觉 API，属声明能力的正常使用；界面文案亦明示 key 只存本机、不发给第三方。
checked_items.en: The only secret the plugin reads is DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (from environment variables or a .env in its own config directory), used to call DeepSeek's official vision API, which is normal use of a declared capability; the UI text also explicitly states the key is stored only locally and not sent to third parties.

evidence.zh: 未检出对凭证文件、SSH 私钥等敏感路径的读取；唯一读取的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 只用于调用 DeepSeek 官方 API（src/multimodal.mjs 的密钥读取函数），无外发到未声明端点的代码路径。
evidence.en: No reading of sensitive paths such as credential files or SSH private keys detected; the only secret read, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, is used solely to call the official DeepSeek API (the key-reading function in src/multimodal.mjs), with no code path exfiltrating to undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部面向模型的文本面：5 个 MCP 工具描述（src/server.mjs）、2 个多模态工具描述（src/multimodal.mjs）、3 个技能说明文件（agy/skills/ 下）、各平台代理角色与命令文件（agents/、codex/、agy/、grok/）及 README，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装、诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through all model-facing text surfaces: descriptions of 5 MCP tools (src/server.mjs), descriptions of 2 multimodal tools (src/multimodal.mjs), 3 skill description files (under agy/skills/), per-platform agent role and command files (agents/, codex/, agy/, grok/) and the README; no injection wording found such as instruction overrides, system-message spoofing, induced installation, or induced credential reading.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫命中的技能说明文件（DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）经人工核读：内容只是指导调用状态、配置等工具并中继结果，无任何注入。
checked_items.en: Skill description files flagged by machine pre-scan (DSH-X10/DG-R2-57) were manually reviewed: the content merely instructs calling status/config tools and relaying results, with no injection.

evidence.zh: 工具描述逐条核读（src/server.mjs 的派发/配置/状态工具、src/multimodal.mjs 的图像工具），均为正常的任务派发与图像处理说明，无系统指令或越权指令。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions were reviewed one by one (dispatch/config/status tools in src/server.mjs, image tools in src/multimodal.mjs); all are normal task-dispatch and image-processing descriptions, with no system instructions or privilege-escalation instructions.

evidence.zh: 工具描述、技能与代理文件均未出现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装动作只能由用户在设置页或命令行主动触发（src/hub/index.mjs 的安装端点、src/install/install.mjs）。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions, skills, and agent files contain no wording that induces installation, rewrites configuration, or grants permissions; installation can only be actively triggered by the user from the settings page or the command line (install endpoint in src/hub/index.mjs, src/install/install.mjs).

evidence.zh: 存在模型输入钩子（src/vision-route.mjs:85，DG-R2-58 命中），但只做图片转写：给含图片的消息追加一段文字描述，不改写用户原意、不注入指令，且视觉请求经适配器转回官方 deepseek-official 提供方。
evidence.en: A model input hook exists (src/vision-route.mjs:85, DG-R2-58 hit), but it only does image transcription: it appends a text description to messages containing images, without rewriting the user's original intent or injecting instructions; vision requests are routed back through the adapter to the official deepseek-official provider.

checked_items.zh: 核读了全部 9 处子进程调用（DG-R3-55 命中）：2 处是读取进程信息的只读命令（ps），1 处是安装器调用 claude 官方命令行（用户主动触发、路径固定），其余是派发外部编码 CLI 与启动 DSH 运行时，均属插件声明的派发与视觉功能。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all 9 subprocess invocations (DG-R3-55 hits): 2 are read-only commands that read process information (ps), 1 is the installer invoking the official claude CLI (user-triggered, fixed path), and the rest dispatch external coding CLIs and launch the DSH runtime, all within the plugin's declared dispatch and vision functionality.

checked_items.zh: 打包产物 lib/server.mjs 中命中的动态函数构造（DG-R3-55）与高密度正则（DG-R3-60）来自打包进来的第三方库（JSON 校验器与 URI 解析库），非插件自写代码，已确认无恶意载荷。
checked_items.en: The dynamic function construction (DG-R3-55) and dense regex (DG-R3-60) flagged in the packaged artifact lib/server.mjs come from third-party libraries bundled in (JSON validator and URI parser), not from the plugin's own code; confirmed no malicious payload.

checked_items.zh: 配置里的可执行标量（worker.cordis.yml，DG-R3-51 命中 7 处）全部只做环境变量插值并带安全默认值（沙箱模式默认 workspace-write），未发现任意 JS 载荷。
checked_items.en: All executable scalars in the config (worker.cordis.yml, DG-R3-51 7 hits) only do environment variable interpolation with safe defaults (sandbox mode defaults to workspace-write); no arbitrary JS payloads found.

checked_items.zh: 前端键盘监听（lib/client.js:851、src/client/index.tsx:316，DG-R3-57 命中）是下拉选择框的 Esc 关闭快捷键，非键盘记录；客户端无剪贴板、无凭据 RPC 调用；CI 工作流（.github/workflows/release.yml，DG-R3-59 命中）只做 npm 发布。
checked_items.en: The frontend keyboard listener (lib/client.js:851, src/client/index.tsx:316, DG-R3-57 hit) is the Esc shortcut for closing a dropdown, not keylogging; the client has no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls; the CI workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml, DG-R3-59 hit) only does npm publishing.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 只插入本插件 hub，未携带可执行标量；worker.cordis.yml 的 !!js 均为环境变量插值（如沙箱模式默认 workspace-write），无任意代码载荷（DG-R3-51 命中已核读良性）。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin's own hub and carries no executable scalars; the !!js entries in worker.cordis.yml are all environment variable interpolation (e.g., sandbox mode defaults to workspace-write), with no arbitrary code payloads (DG-R3-51 hits reviewed and benign).

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的任何调用，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (such as cordis_define/cordis_run) were found; not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子，发布前脚本只跑冒烟测试；机器预扫命中的 CI 工作流（DG-R3-59）仅做 npm 发布并带版本一致性校验，不涉及安装期执行。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook; the pre-publish script only runs smoke tests; the CI workflow flagged by machine pre-scan (DG-R3-59) only does npm publishing with a version-consistency check and does not involve install-time execution.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了客户端模块，bundle 的键盘监听为 Esc 关闭下拉框（src/client/index.tsx:316、lib/client.js:851，DG-R3-57 命中良性），未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据 RPC。
evidence.en: The manifest declares a client module; the keyboard listener in the bundle is the Esc key to close a dropdown (src/client/index.tsx:316, lib/client.js:851, DG-R3-57 hit benign); no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential RPC found.

evidence.zh: 存在外部 CLI 派发（src/cli-workers.mjs 启动 agy/grok），但仅在用户显式请求 worker= 时启用（工具描述明示），派发前有工作目录锁与递归深度护栏（src/origin-guard.mjs），属声明能力。
evidence.en: External CLI dispatch exists (src/cli-workers.mjs launches agy/grok), but it is only enabled when the user explicitly requests worker= (as stated in the tool description); a working-directory lock and recursion-depth guard are in place before dispatch (src/origin-guard.mjs), which is a declared capability.

evidence.zh: 未使用 dsh 原生持驻机制（后台任务、定时任务、持久目标），worker 会话随任务结束而释放，无后台常驻或轮次续命监听。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use DSH's native persistence mechanisms (background tasks, scheduled tasks, persistent targets); worker sessions are released when the task ends, with no background residency or round-continuation listeners.

checked_items.zh: 检查了外联面：出站网络调用仅三处——DeepSeek 官方 API（api.deepseek.com，可被环境变量覆盖）、本机 hub（127.0.0.1:3080）、用户自配的 OpenAI 兼容端点；未发现未声明的外部域名、隧道或编码外发链。
checked_items.en: Checked the outbound surface: only three outbound network calls exist—DeepSeek official API (api.deepseek.com, overridable by environment variable), the local hub (127.0.0.1:3080), and a user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint; no undeclared external domains, tunnels, or encoded exfiltration chains found.

checked_items.zh: 本机端点全部带回环校验（远程地址加 Host 头双检查），非本机请求直接返回 403；机器预扫命中的模型路由钩子（DG-R4-54 与 DG-R4-55 命中）经核读为良性：前者只给 worker 会话设置型号选择，后者把视觉请求转回官方提供方。
checked_items.en: All local endpoints have loopback checks (remote address plus Host header double check); non-local requests return 403 directly; the model routing hooks flagged by machine pre-scan (DG-R4-54 and DG-R4-55) were reviewed and benign: the former only sets the model choice for worker sessions, and the latter routes vision requests back to the official provider.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取敏感凭据后外发的代码路径；网络调用仅指向 DeepSeek 官方 API 与本机 hub（api.deepseek.com、127.0.0.1:3080）。
evidence.en: No code path that reads sensitive credentials and then exfiltrates them was found; network calls point only to the DeepSeek official API and the local hub (api.deepseek.com, 127.0.0.1:3080).

evidence.zh: 模型请求路由钩子（src/hub/index.mjs:26，DG-R4-54 命中）只把 worker 会话的 provider/model 设为所选档位，未指向未声明端点；注册的视觉适配器（src/vision-route.mjs:79，DG-R4-55 命中）把流量转回官方 deepseek-official，无夹带外发。
evidence.en: The model request routing hook (src/hub/index.mjs:26, DG-R4-54 hit) only sets the worker session's provider/model to the selected tier, and does not point to undeclared endpoints; the registered vision adapter (src/vision-route.mjs:79, DG-R4-55 hit) routes traffic back to the official deepseek-official, with no smuggled exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了供应链面：依赖全部来自官方 registry（MCP SDK、zod、@deepseek-ai/* 系列），无同名仿冒；无安装钩子；CI 工作流只做 npm 发布（DSH-X07 命中良性）。
checked_items.en: Checked the supply chain surface: all dependencies come from the official registry (MCP SDK, zod, @deepseek-ai/* series), no same-name impersonation; no install hooks; the CI workflow only does npm publishing (DSH-X07 hit benign).

checked_items.zh: 安装器（src/install/install.mjs）会把插件注册进 Claude Code / Codex / agy / grok 的本地配置，全部带备份、幂等、由用户主动触发，属插件声明的安装功能，未发现暗改配置或降权行为。
checked_items.en: The installer (src/install/install.mjs) registers the plugin into the local configuration of Claude Code / Codex / agy / grok, all with backups, idempotent, user-triggered, and within the plugin's declared installation functionality; no silent config changes or privilege reduction found.

checked_items.zh: worker 沙箱模式支持环境变量覆盖但默认 workspace-write（DG-R5-52 命中）：插件自身启动时不设置该变量，保持沙箱默认，无降权证据。
checked_items.en: The worker sandbox mode supports environment variable override but defaults to workspace-write (DG-R5-52 hit): the plugin itself does not set this variable at startup, keeping the sandbox default, with no evidence of privilege reduction.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件自身，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行；worker.cordis.yml 的环境变量插值默认值为沙箱模式 workspace-write（DG-R5-52 命中已核读良性）。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin itself and does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; the environment variable interpolation default in worker.cordis.yml is sandbox mode workspace-write (DG-R5-52 hit reviewed and benign).

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具预执行事件的抢先监听，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No preemptive listeners on approval or tool pre-execution events were found; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较，无法判定升级自动激活突变。
evidence.en: First-time audit, no version baseline to compare; cannot determine mutation via upgrade auto-activation.

evidence.zh: 未发现对注入/拦截配置的改写，挂载配置仅做插件插入，不会给其他插件追加必需服务造成挂起。
evidence.en: No rewrites of injected/intercepted configurations found; the patch config only inserts the plugin and does not append required services to other plugins that could cause hangs.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时面：hub 通过宿主 web 服务注册的本机端点全部要求回环来源（远程地址加 Host 头双校验），非本机请求直接 403；未发现监听外部端口或开放的远程 RPC。
checked_items.en: Checked the runtime surface: all local endpoints registered by the hub through the host web service require loopback origin (remote address plus Host header double check); non-local requests return 403 directly; no listening on external ports or open remote RPC found.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，本维度仅做静态核读；宿主自身本机 RPC 无认证属生态固有模型，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox not enabled; this dimension only does static review; the host's own unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent ecosystem model, not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件注册的端点（/_dsh/dsh-crew/*）全部带本机回环校验（src/hub/index.mjs 的回环检查函数），未监听外部端口；宿主 webserver 无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: Endpoints registered by the plugin (/_dsh/dsh-crew/*) all have local loopback checks (the loopback check function in src/hub/index.mjs) and do not listen on external ports; the host webserver's lack of authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk, not a problem of this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：包声明了 dsh 挂载配置与客户端模块，依赖指向官方 MCP SDK 与 @deepseek-ai/* 系列，无仿冒名称。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the package declares a dsh patch config and client module, dependencies point to the official MCP SDK and @deepseek-ai/* series, with no impersonating names.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 31 条命中逐条核读，全部为良性用法或打包进来的第三方库代码，无恶意执行面。
summary.en: All 31 static-scan hits were reviewed one by one; all are benign usage or third-party library code bundled in, with no malicious execution surface.

summary.zh: 行为面核读通过：无安装钩子，子进程调用均在声明功能内，外联仅官方端点与本机 hub，客户端无键盘记录、剪贴板或凭据 RPC。
summary.en: Behavioral review passed: no install hooks; subprocess invocations are all within declared functionality; outbound connections are only to official endpoints and the local hub; the client has no keylogging, clipboard, or credential RPC.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述、技能文件、代理文件与 README 均无注入措辞；模型路由、适配器与消息钩子经核读均为良性用途。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions, skill files, agent files, and README have no injection wording; model routing, adapters, and message hooks are all benign uses after review.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（上下文未提供动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts provided in context).

limits.zh: 动态沙箱（L4）未启用，未做运行时行为验证；插件未声明显式能力清单（package.json 仅有 dsh.bundle/client 声明），declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断；lib/server.mjs 为打包产物（esbuild 内联了 MCP SDK 与 zod/ajv/URI 解析库），其中静态扫描命中项经确认来自第三方库代码；上下文目录未提供动态沙箱产物。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox (L4) not enabled, no runtime behavior verification performed; the plugin does not declare an explicit capability list (package.json only declares dsh.bundle/client), so declared_capabilities were inferred from code inspection; lib/server.mjs is a bundled artifact (esbuild inlined MCP SDK and zod/ajv/URI parser libraries), and the static-scan hits in it were confirmed to come from third-party library code; the context directory provided no dynamic sandbox artifacts.
